summary: Tested new Master Admin AI-photo spend feature end-to-end. Backend endpoint GET /api/admin/ai-photos/spend passes all 5 pytest cases (schema+math, 401 unauth, 403 non-master, both-shape aggregation using scratch rows [count_generated:3 + filled:2 = 5 images / ₹17.5], and empty-collection returns zeros). Frontend Master Dashboard renders the violet-bordered ai-spend-card above the Weekly-admin-email card with correct data-testids (ai-spend-card, ai-spend-mtd, ai-spend-30d) showing MTD ₹14 / 4 images and 30-day ₹14 / 4 images which matches the endpoint payload.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor spec drift (non-blocking): the spec says the card should render only when images>0, but the frontend renders whenever aiSpend is truthy (i.e. also when the endpoint returns all zeros). Consider gating on aiSpend.all_time.images > 0 (or last_30_days) to hide the card on fresh installs.

aiSpend fields are accessed with .toLocaleString on spend_inr and images assumed present; a defensive optional-chaining or a schema guard would prevent a runtime crash if the endpoint response ever changes shape.
seed_data_creation: Two scratch rows briefly inserted into ai_image_generations for both-shape aggregation test; deleted in finally block. Also temporarily wipes+restores ai_image_generations inside the empty-collection test; verified restore path via backup list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoint currently returns {price_per_image_inr:3.5, month_to_date:{rows:4,images:4,spend_inr:14,since:'2026-08-01T00:00:00+00:00'}, last_30_days:{...images:4,spend_inr:14}, all_time:{rows:6,images:6,spend_inr:21}}. Preview clock is in Aug-2026. Frontend card lives at /master/dashboard between orphan-warning and weekly-email cards. bcrypt-hashed scratch employee used for the 403 test since no public register endpoint exists.
